Convex is a decentralized finance protocol built on top of Curve Finance on public blockchains. Convex allows users to deposit Curve liquidity provider tokens so that they can earn boosted CRV rewards without locking CRV themselves. Convex pools aggregate CRV voting power from users who deposit into it. Convex issues its governance token CVX as an additional reward to users who stake in its pools. Convex operates without a central intermediary and runs through smart contracts.
